title: Google's anti-nausea Motion Assist dots finally rolling out on Android
summary: Google’s version is similar, but it’s called Motion Assist. If Motion Assist is available on your phone, you’ll find it in the Google services settings, usually nested one level below the main settings: Settings > Your profile > All services.
